title: One-tape action serialization
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every action of a one-work-tape binary machine with state set of size $n+1$, the serialization formed by listing its input-head move, its work-tape write and head move, its output symbol, and its successor state agrees with the serialization formed by listing the same data through the general $k$-tape procedure with $k=1$.
hypotheses_covered: the action has one work tape
